coverage.basis: model assets in baseq2/pak10.pak; covered = present in demo1 (in hand for weapons, placed as a pickup or monster in the BSP entity lump). Enemy visibility in a particular frame is not claimed.

limitations: The runner forces headless Chrome onto ANGLE/SwiftShader (--use-angle=swiftshader --enable-unsafe-swiftshader); the box's Intel GPU is not exercised, so every frame time is software and is not the owner's frame rate.
The engine renders at the r_mode the runner sets (14 = 1280x720, 25 = 2560x1440); screenshots are the viewport at the same size.

Only demo1 (Outer Base) is driven; the crosshair's weapon test switches to the shotgun and back with the engine's own weapon binds. Enemy coverage is level placement in demo1, not per-frame visibility.

Game mode's multi-display blackout needs the Window Management API and a second display. This headless run has one display and no such permission, so it checks the mode's honest report of that (`blackout`), not a real second monitor going black; the single-display presentation, the frame cost and the page restoration are exercised.
Audio, pointer lock, mouse look and saved games are not exercised by this headless run.
20 rAF samples give a nearest-rank p95; it is a small sample and not a percentile-tail measurement.

row.label: game mode
row.help: video mode is the engine's own r_mode list (its 33 modes, then auto and custom); HD (1280x720) is the default and applying restarts the level at the chosen mode. field of view stops at 90 because this build draws no view weapon above it (measured: 91° and up drops the gun). Applying writes the values into the engine's config.cfg and restarts the level, so they survive later visits. game mode (Alt+Enter while the game has the keyboard) is this page's native-game presentation: the game surface alone, every page control hidden, and the page black outside the picture. It asks for full screen on the display the game is on; on a desktop where the Window Management API is allowed it also blacks out each additional display. Esc leaves full screen and the mode. For plain full screen with the page interface kept, use the Full screen control over the game. The engine's own vid_fullscreen row is not offered: in this browser build it does not enter full screen, so it was a control that did nothing.
